name: Export Biz WebMCP Server
description: Model Context Protocol tools exposed by Export Biz enabling AI agents to schedule software demonstrations and request trade consultancy callbacks.

tools.name: requestDemo
tools.description: Submits an enquiry to Export Biz to request a free live demo of export documentation, compliance, and trade operations software.

full_name.description: Full name of the exporter or business representative requesting the demo.

email_id.description: Business email address for sending software demo credentials and schedule.

mobile_no.description: 10-digit mobile phone number for verification and coordination.

remarks.description: Optional notes regarding shipment volume, products exported, or specific software needs.

tools.name: requestCallback
tools.description: Requests an immediate callback from the Export Biz export advisory team using a 10-digit phone number.

mobile_no.description: 10-digit mobile phone number to receive a direct call from sales.
